subject: Renewal & capacity top-up — SummitX: PO + EIN / invoice hand-off
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Lopez <h.lopez@summitx.io>, SummitX Procurement <procurement@summitx.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity top-up — SummitX: initial scope and PO needed

Hi Hannah / SummitX procurement team,

Great to be working with you on the upcoming renewal. Per our call today, SummitX will renew the existing Dedicated commitment for 12 months and add a 35% capacity top-up (additional GPU-hours) to accommodate the new feature launch. To keep procurement moving, could you please send over a purchase order referencing the attached quote and the deal ID DEAL-2027-00231?

Two items finance flagged we should align on so invoicing goes smoothly:
- Billing entity / payor: you mentioned moving invoicing to SummitX Holdings (new EIN). Please confirm the legal name and EIN to appear on the invoice.
- W-9 / tax form: if we invoice SummitX Holdings (US entity), we will need a W-9. If it's an international entity, we'll need the appropriate W-8 form.

If procurement can share the PO and (if available) the W-9, I'll loop in Marissa on finance to confirm payment terms (requested Net45) and to ensure we set up invoice routing to the right AP contact.

Next steps:
1) SummitX to send PO referencing the attached quote.
2) Provide billing entity name + EIN and W-9.
3) I will confirm final quote and upload signed amendment.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
From: SummitX Procurement <procurement@summitx.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Hannah Lopez <h.lopez@summitx.io>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity top-up — SummitX: initial scope and PO needed

Connor,

Thanks for the summary. Attached is our formal PO (SummitX_PO_2027-03-24.pdf). A couple of clarifications below:

- Billing entity: SummitX Holdings, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- AP contact for invoice delivery: ap@summitx.io (please CC accounting@summitx.io for the first invoice)
- Requested net terms: Net60 (procurement has approved Net60 for this contract)

We are also attaching our standard vendor addendum that references our procurement T&Cs — nothing surprising but wanted to surface it early. Please confirm you can invoice SummitX Holdings and accept Net60. If you require a W-9, we can provide one; otherwise let us know required documents and we'll get them over.

Regards,
Procurement Team
SummitX

Attachments: SummitX_PO_2027-03-24.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity top-up — SummitX: PO + EIN / invoice hand-off

Connor / Monica,

Thanks for the heads up and the PO. A few notes from Finance:
1) Net60 vs our typical Net45 — SummitX is asking Net60. We can accept Net60 for this Enterprise renewal provided we put an explicit aging hold and confirm there's a signed amendment documenting the longer term. Please confirm if Sales is ok with Net60 for this deal ID DEAL-2027-00231.
2) W-9 required: since SummitX Holdings, Inc. is a US entity, please have them send a completed W-9 (PDF). We can't finalize vendor set-up without it.
3) Invoice header must match the PO exactly (legal name + EIN). We will prepare the invoice to: SummitX Holdings, Inc. — EIN 12-3456789 and route to ap@summitx.io with accounting@summitx.io CC.

I've attached a blank vendor W-9 template for convenience. Once we have the signed amendment and W-9, Finance will queue the invoice and confirm payment ETA for the first month.

Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity top-up — SummitX: PO + EIN / invoice hand-off

Connor — quick internal note. Procurement is asking for Net60. Deal team, given the upsell (35% capacity top-up) and strategic nature of the SummitX relationship, I recommend we accept Net60 this cycle but hold the first invoice until we confirm signed amendment and W-9. Also propose we offer a one-time implementation credit of $7,500 to help offset their ramp costs; this would be recorded as a one-line credit on month 1 invoice.

Rishi — please confirm approval for the $7,500 credit and any margin impact we should log. If approved, I'll ask Legal to prepare a short amendment.

Monica
Account Executive, Customer Success (CS)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
To: SummitX Procurement <procurement@summitx.io>, Hannah Lopez <h.lopez@summitx.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity top-up — SummitX: PO + EIN / invoice hand-off (confirming next steps)

Hannah / Procurement team,

Thanks for sending the PO and EIN. Per internal review we're good to accept Net60 for the renewal. A couple of concrete next steps to keep things moving:

1) SummitX to upload a completed W-9 (SummitX_W9.pdf) so Finance can set up the payor.
2) We will prepare a one-page amendment documenting the 35% capacity top-up and the agreed one-time implementation credit of $7,500. Legal will route the DocuSign link to your team — we'll aim to have that out by end of day tomorrow.
3) Once amendment is signed and W-9 is received, Finance (Marissa) will issue the first invoice to SummitX Holdings, Inc. with Net60 terms and will include the $7,500 credit line.

I have attached the signed amendment and a copy of the PO for your records (Signed_Amendment.docx attached on our side once countersigned). Please let me know if the AP email should include anyone else.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — excited to keep supporting SummitX's launch.

Best,
Connor
